text:
marie (product): quick thread 1 — competitor launched per-tenant routing + tiered billing. acme asked for parity. want to decide fast.

ben (sales): renewal in 5w. they want routing by region/tier and a billing webhook for chargebacks.

alex (eng): we have routing primitives in Dedicated but no public API and no metering hook. minimal productization ~6w.

ryan (eng-runtime): key risks: cache coherence when requests hit different model variants, and accurate accounting across fallbacks. need canary plan.

anya (design): i can do a one-page admin mock + copy for PS in 3 days.

sam (growth): avoid "we copied them" messaging. frame as "predictable economics + routing controls".

marie (product): options: A) fast minimal API + PS (6w) B) full self-serve UI + templates (9w) C) invest in differentiated cost-driven routing feature (4w but higher risk).

ben (sales): ACME accepts PS if we give a firm date. prefer full but will take minimal with roadmap promise.

alex (eng): for option A we freeze scope: API + metering + default fallback policy + RBAC hooks. can commit to 6w with one patch week after canary.

marie (product): decision: go option A (fast parity) with cost-control framing. action items: @alex eng plan, @ryan canary + telemetry, @anya docs+mock, @ben customer comms. reconvene after canary start.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: routing-api v0.1 -> staging at 3170027200.
